name: GRAPH_V2_OFFLINE_PILOT_01
scope: Offline mechanism validation; oracle geometry; saved S0 PP data only

selection.ranking: Actual applied PP abs(delta_w); median is numpy median of eligible switches; ties use ascending FRESH ID
selection.deduplicate: If maximum and median select the same ID, retain one case with both roles
selection.eligibility: Applied OLD and FRESH, both valid XY paths and valid control at switch, positive recorded horizon; malformed or missing source data aborts preflight
selection.exclusions: Initial switch without OLD, terminal received but unapplied, invalid/expired OLD or FRESH, zero recorded horizon
selection.heading_failure: Not a selection filter; retain case and report correction rejection

horizon_rule: min(16, next switch tick minus B tick, final saved tick minus B tick); integrate up to that pose without applying the next switch command
entry_rule: Existing XYPath.project on RAW at B, outgoing segment at a vertex; freeze original endpoint indices and interpolation fraction for all boundary factors/diagnostics. PP itself keeps its original projection rule.
heading_rule: For each node choose the nearest later node with chord length >=20mm; if none, the nearest earlier node with >=20mm chord, oriented in path order. Freeze these indices before solving; reject if any node has no such chord. These are auxiliary headings, not native yaw.
rigid_rule: One SE(2) transform aligning initial node 0 position and its valid auxiliary heading to B; preserve all relative transforms

factors.boundary: SE(2) log from fixed B to fixed-entry interpolated editable pose
factors.pp_continuity: First actual clipped PurePursuit w minus previous actual PP w; clipping plateaus are retained
factors.anti_shrink: Hinges on each original segment ratio, total XY length ratio and frozen heading chord ratio
factors.safety: Native full polyline plus B-to-fixed-entry connector; PP 9Hz refreshed rollout with 72Hz swept checks; separate obstacle/corridor hinges

solver.initialization: Zero additive XY/yaw increments at observation-anchored FRESH; one solve per selected case; no restarts

improvement_rule.rule: Converged if GRAPH; smaller switch abs(delta_w), native and rollout safe, no obstacle/corridor minimum degradation beyond tolerance versus RAW, no added endpoint stop, sufficient motion and retained path length. Report tradeoffs separately.
